annotations.text:
One structural change:
the canvas now runs full-bleed and the top bar floats on it.

Glass over an opaque #121212 rail refracts nothing, so the bar had to leave the shell. Same argument for the AI panel.
Paper is the harder case: a transparent panel over #faf9f6 disappears, so on light the core carries its own white tint and the bottom bezel becomes a shadow instead of a highlight.
